title: Iteration 2: harder eval fixtures and the gaps iteration 1 found
description: From iteration-1 (evals/benchmarks/iteration-1) and the run transcripts. Not started: waits on the owner's review of the iteration-1 outputs in the eval viewer.

acceptanceCriteria.text: repo_inventory.py reports outside services called by raw URL (e.g. https://api.shipengine.com) with the calling file as evidence
Skills run lore commands only when the repository has a lore bundle (.lore/config.toml), so no cache directory is left in repositories without one
schema_er.py accepts plain display names for beginner views, so generated output needs no hand rewording
At least one harder fixture exists where the truth checks discriminate: stale docs naming a removed service, or a larger repository
Iteration 2 runs 3 times per arm and records variance in evals/benchmarks/iteration-2/
The owner's iteration-1 viewer feedback is read and each point is either addressed or answered
